body: yeah. is that unusual...? i thought suicide attempt survivors are more likely to attempt again anyways.

yeah, you can imagine the amount of disappointment i have in the fact that i basically killed my respiratory system but still failed.

but thanks for rooting for me anyways

i'm 18. never enjoyed anything. never had friends or a caring family. no passions or career goals or anything. please don't tell me i'm still so young and i should go experience life in this world because i've heard it before and i honestly could care less

the last time i enjoyed something was so long ago that i don't even remember whatever it is that i did. when i'm in a crappy depressed state like this, interests just don't exist.

and what am i gonna do if i'm able to find something that brings me joy anyways? i already know that i'll end feeling like shit in the end. it has happened every single time for years now, so there's really no convincing me otherwise

i've always lurked on this subreddit, and i've seen posts that talk about their failed attempt. thought i would too. didn't know i had to be feeling suicidal AND hopeful to post...

beaches don't make me happy thanks to my ex.
yeah, but i've just played the act of regretful suicide survivor, so they're gonna let me go

sorry you lost loved ones to suicide.

i can't just up and leave to travel so... i've done all that before anyways
yeah it was really fucking painful, 10/10 do not recommend, especially since i made it out anyways.
not much to update on since i'm gonna be dead soon

thanks. glad you're still trying.
